title: The way in, in context
question: The opening you said was fine, now shown with the ground it comes out of. The gnome is standing on the dune above; the passage zig-zags down through the beds and reaches the chamber at bottom left, where the crystal is. It is an incline rather than a shaft -- one row down for every two along -- so it can be walked. Everything is smoother than the version you saw: the walls are filtered rather than left as the collapse cut them. Is it smooth enough, and does the descent read as somewhere you would go?
